name: Arcturus Siege Platform
description: A massive tracked vehicle the size of a small building, serving as a mobile command center and area-denial platform. The Siege Platform is deployed only in extreme circumstances — corporate warfare, district-scale security operations, or situations where a corponation has decided that a piece of geography needs to change hands. It carries a crew of 30, a drone bay, communications suite, and enough firepower to level a city block. GLMZ has seen three Siege Platform deployments in the last decade. Nobody wants to see a fourth.
tier_availability: Military only — deployment requires corporate board authorization
armament: Classified. Includes directed-energy weapons, missile systems, drone deployment bay, area-denial countermeasures.
story_hooks: A Siege Platform deployment is authorized for a Tier 1 district and the residents have 48 hours to evacuate — but there's nowhere to go
An Arcturus Siege Platform from the Corporate Wars is found buried in the Underworld, intact and powered down but not off
physical_description: A massive tracked colossus of weathered steel and composite plating, roughly 80 meters long and 12 stories tall, its hull scarred with impact marks and streaked with rust-colored rain stains. Articulated sensor arrays and gun turrets protrude at irregular angles from its sloped armor; the tracks are each the size of a transport truck, treads caked with industrial sludge and debris. Faded Arcturus Defense markings barely visible beneath layers of grime; three vertical exhaust stacks belch thin smoke, and running lights glow weak amber through corroded fixtures.
